metadata.name: Gaia DR4 best
metadata.description: Star catalog based on Gaia DR4 with only the very best stars in terms of parallax relative error. Contains all stars with up to 0.4%/0.002% bright/faint parallax relative error, and all Hipparcos stars.
metadata.creator: Toni Sagristà, tsagrista@ari.uni-heidelberg.de

metadata.name: Gaia DR4 default
metadata.description: Star catalog based on Gaia DR4, with a good balance between good distances and number of stars. Contains all stars with up to 20%/1.5% bright/faint parallax relative error, and all Hipparcos stars.
metadata.creator: Toni Sagristà, tsagrista@ari.uni-heidelberg.de
